tool.name: domain_recon_pipeline
tool.description:
Run the full deterministic domain-target recon pipeline as a single orchestrated call.
This is the §8.3 "specialist team" entry point for domain targets. It composes the existing recon tools (org_fingerprint, dns_hygiene_check, passive_dns_history, subdomain_takeover_check, discover_cloud_assets) plus subfinder-based subdomain enumeration plus a per-subdomain HEAD-probing triage classifier — all bracketed in one phase.entered/phase.completed pair, with a `surface_map.json` artifact persisted for the exploit phase to consume.
Use this near the start of any domain-target scan. Order:
1. **(External step)** Call `fingerprint_tech_stack(target)` first if you want the per-tech skills auto-loaded — that tool is host-side and needs agent_state, so it can't run inside this orchestrator. 2. **This tool** runs the deterministic recon checks + builds the surface map. 3. **Then** the agent enters exploit phase, reading `deep_targets` from the surface map for the per-host web-app exploit reasoning.
What gets emitted as a side effect: - `phase.entered` / `phase.completed` events around the whole pipeline - All check events from the underlying tools (per-DNS-hygiene-check, per-subdomain takeover, per-provider passive DNS, etc.) - All findings the underlying tools normally emit (DNS hygiene misconfigs, takeover candidates, cloud-asset exposures, typosquats) - `surface_map.json` written to the run directory
Triage classification per subdomain: - **deep** — likely a web app or auth-protected surface worth deep testing (200/301/302 with HTML or JSON, or 401/403) - **shallow** — live but probably not a primary target (static content, redirects) - **skip** — doesn't resolve, 5xx, or no HTTP response

parameter.name: enable_typosquats
parameter.description: When true (default), generate and DNS-resolve ~25 typosquat candidates inside org_fingerprint.

parameter.name: enable_passive_dns
parameter.description: When true (default), invoke passive_dns_history. Fails open when no API keys configured.

parameter.name: enable_cloud_assets
parameter.description: When true (default), invoke discover_cloud_assets across S3/GCS/Azure.

parameter.name: subdomain_max
parameter.description: Cap on number of subdomains to triage + takeover-check. Default 50, to bound HTTP probe count on large domains.

parameter.name: triage_subdomains
parameter.description: When true (default), HEAD-probe each live subdomain and classify it as deep / shallow / skip.

returns.description:
{success, domain, phase_id, surface_map: {...}, next_steps: [...]}.
`surface_map` is the same structure persisted to `surface_map.json`: schema_version, domain, generated_at, phase_id, summary (counts), org_fingerprint, dns_hygiene, passive_dns, subdomain_enum, subdomain_triage, deep_targets, shallow_targets, takeover, cloud_assets.
`next_steps` is a compact list of suggested follow-up actions for the agent based on what was discovered.
